title: Cliff Booth
description: We partnered with Starline Tours to bring guests into the seedy Hollywood world of Cliff Booth through a custom mis-adventures bus tour.
headline: “You guys really did the ’70s right!” - guest
intro: IHC produced a 1977's inspired starline bus tour around los angeles for netflix's premiere ofthe misadventures of cliff booth.

introPieces.html:
We partnered with Starline Tours to bring guests into the seedy Hollywood world of Cliff Booth through a custom mis-adventures bus tour that blended historical storytelling and unexpected surprises.

The tour offered a unique and compelling perspective of Cliff Booth’s world ahead of the film’s premiere. Guests experienced a mix of behind-the-scenes Hollywood insights and visual moments designed for capture, with a mid-way F&B stop at a local tiki bar.

pieces.html: We transformed one 21-passenger and two 27-passenger Starline Tour buses into rolling tributes to the film’s ’70s-era world, carrying its look and feel onto the streets of Hollywood. Retro graphics wrapped every side of the buses, with the film’s title treatment and logos repeated across the exterior. The all-around design ensured the branding was visible from every angle. Each seat featured a custom cover, with the film’s title treatment on every other one. Bright vinyl wraps and decorative side skirting carried the look throughout the interiors, while fuzzy dice and a dashboard hula girl added era-inspired finishing touches.

pieces.left: The tour featured locations tied to the film, alongside longtime Hollywood landmarks that evoke the era. Highlights included Astro Burger and Lucy's El Adobe, both appearing in the film. The Cinerama Dome, Vista Theatre, and New Beverly Cinema connected the tour to the moviegoing culture and cinematic influences that shaped Tarantino’s films.
pieces.right: Before boarding, guests received a branded brochure that previewed the tour route and introduced in-world details. Once aboard, guests were welcomed with ’70s-era snacks, branded sunglasses, and a Polaroid camera with film to capture moments from the tour. Beginning and ending in the heart of Hollywood, the route connected iconic landmarks and filming locations.

pieces.html: Guests got to experience one of the locations up close with a pit stop to The Lucky Tiki in West Hollywood during the afternoon tour. The Lucky Tiki stop began with Mai Tais at the welcome bar, giving guests a lively first taste of the experience. Inside, mirror decals, props, and in-period memorabilia added character to the experience. The patio extended the experience outdoors, with more memorabilia and props bringing the film’s world to life. Posters from films that inspired the movie, alongside other Quentin Tarantino titles, highlighted additional cinematic influences.

work.summary: We partnered with Starline Tours to bring guests into the seedy Hollywood world of Cliff Booth through a custom mis-adventures bus tour that blended historical storytelling and unexpected surprises.
